baseline.method: Repository sourcewise Dual-CIE, projected four-corner Fourier coordinates and exact shared-real CIE material readout
baseline.training_data: 8 calibrated nominal terminated transmit ports by 8 calibrated nominal terminated receive ports; fixed dressed Green
baseline.material_prior: R8 smooth=1e-4 and smoothed TV=1e-4, epsilon=.01; unchanged coefficients
baseline.retained_stage_rule: lowest original full-wave training loss plus common prior among converged stage endpoints and initial incumbent; final converged endpoint also saved

roi.method: Smooth baseline with sigma=side/32 cells, then threshold at max(0.25,0.40*peak); four-connected components, ranked by smoothed contrast sum
roi.fallback: Strongest threshold component if all rejected by size; peak pixel if empty
roi.background_tiles: Four quadrants of low smoothed contrast (strictly below half the foreground threshold), excluding retained components

B1.ordering: Test each frozen component; choose in-ball ROI with smallest contrast integral, then lowest residual. Freeze single removal only
B1.controls: ordinary continuation for the same 64 CIE updates; ordinary physical objective with same single-thread wall budget spent by all witness fits and constrained refinement

B2.method: Penalty on the eight most negative directions of P_kerS K P_kerS with uniform sector [0,4.5]; retain negative eigenvalues only
B2.weight: Match initial auxiliary penalty between current ridge, deterministic random receiver-null subspace and K-negative subspace to 10% of initial CIE state energy, at most coefficient 1
B2.controls: ordinary continuation, isotropic current ridge and equal-rank random projected receiver-null modes

timing: Single BLAS thread, single FFT worker, per-arm CPU/wall and original full-wave solve counters. Case pair runs serially. No truth or measured held port array is accessed by fit and selection.
